_about: The route-feel gate's stated reasons (node tools/flow-audit.js gate; docs/ROUTE-FEEL.md). Each row accepts one check the candidate's flow audit fails against the shipped guides: `check` (score, backtracks_avoidable, passed_givers_near, passed_enders for a guide; back_and_forth, wasted_min, carried_far, carried_hours, never_handed, log_cap for a branch), the `guide` or `branch` it names ("*" for all), and the `mode` and `faction` it holds in (left out or "*": all; "run*": every mode with dungeons on Run). `reason` says why the route is better that way for players, on our own evidence: levels, time carried, a dangerous spot, a fixed report. Rows sorted by faction, guide or branch, check.

reasons.reason: Dun Morogh (Dwarf and Gnome starts): Grund and Gozwin (97277) is taken from Grund at Anvilmar's door after Grik'nir, on the walk north to the tunnel, instead of on the first Anvilmar visit, so its Snow Leopard Prowler (6) comes at about 5.4 instead of 4.8 (recordings: 25th percentile 4.82 at the old step); about 400 yd and under 4 minutes. The Riverglades are part of the route after Stranglethorn Vale: one walk back inside them, about 350 yards in Sunnyglade for Apprentice Claire's Abominable Magics, among about 90 quests that replace most of the grinding the 40-50 guides asked for (level model: about 1,160 to 280 minutes).

Seeking Wisdom (269, from Sven at 31, for Bishop Farthing in Stormwind on the Hillsbrad guide) was carried 118 minutes and is now carried a few minutes over two hours: Worgen in the Woods' Tainted Ones (30-31) moved to the end of the Duskwood visit, about a level later, because players met them at 29 (recordings: 25th percentile 29.8, 5 people died there). The Riverglades now come between Stranglethorn Vale and the Badlands & Hinterlands: the quests taken in Stranglethorn and at Thelsamar for the Badlands (Ghak Healtouch's mushrooms among them) ride through the zone, three more carried quests for about 90 more on the way.

Quests whose mobs are too high on the visit that passes their giver are now taken there and carried to the visit that does them, instead of walking past the giver and coming back for it: Syndicate Assassins (Southshore to the Arathi road), Tiger, Raptor and Panther Mastery and Troll Witchery (Stranglethorn's first and second loops to the later Stranglethorn visits), Claim Rackmore's Treasure! (first Desolace visit to the south loop) and Safety Checks (the 30-40 Badlands loop to the 40-50 one); and the Riverglades come between Stranglethorn and the Badlands, which the quests taken for the Badlands ride through. About 230 more quest-hours in the log (flow model), the quest log stays at 32 or under.
On the Mount Hyjal route the six quests of the last trip are now handed in after the zone instead of never; carrying them through Hyjal is the price.

The Riverglades and Shen'dralas are part of the route: the ride in through Blackrock Pass and between the Riverglades' hubs, and the trip from Theramore through Desolace into Shen'dralas and down into Feralas, about 24 minutes more walking at walking speed (less mounted, from level 40). They add about 100 quests and the level model's time to 60 drops from about 131 to 118 hours.

The passed givers are Blackrock Blockade, Blackrock Menace and Alther's Mill, taken on Redridge's second visit, which works them, instead of carried 7-8 hours.

The passed givers are Retrieval for Mauren, taken on the Mage Quarter stop right before its work instead of carried more than 8 hours, and Raene's An Aggressive Defense and Culling the Threat, taken on 06-wetlands' Ashenvale trip at about 29 because their mobs (24-25) were 2 over players here.

Lifting the Curse (290) is taken from First Mate Fitzsimmons on the Hillsbrad guide's Menethil stop at about 31: Captain Halyndor (30) was two over players here at 28 (recordings: 25th percentile 27.9).

Worgen in the Woods' Tainted Ones (30-31) are hunted at the end of the Duskwood visit, about a level later, because players met them at 29 (recordings: 25th percentile 29.8, 5 people died there): one more short stop.

Lifting the Curse, The Eye of Paleth and Cleansing the Eye (290, 292, 293) are done here at about 31 instead of at 28 in the Wetlands guide (Captain Halyndor 30): the Menethil and Stormwind stops gain hand-ins and two short stops.
Where's the Key? (Zimmix Sputterspark, caged in the Bloodscalp ruins) is taken on the Savage Coast step once a Bloodscalp has dropped his key; the route passes his cage on that coast before it.

The Syndicate camp (Thieves 33-34, Wizards 34-35) is worked on this guide's road north at about 37 instead of at 32 in the Hillsbrad guide, and Faldir's Cove (naga 38-40, water elementals 40) is a group choice at 38.
Archmage Ansirem takes Magical Analysis on the Dalaran camp stop a few minutes after the Image of Archmage Modera, on the same lake shore (about 90 yards).

Sigrun's scrap is collected from the Dustbelcher Ogres (38-39) on the Dustbowl's west side with the Lesser Rock Elementals, away from Agmond's End's 40-43 ogre camp; Lotwil takes the shards on the way back from them, about seven minutes later.

Akiris by the Bundle, Zanzil's Secret, Voodoo Dues and Stranglethorn Fever are taken on the level-48 Booty Bay stop (40-50/05), where they are done: their naga, Zanzil's followers and Mokk (43-46) are two to four over players here at 41, and carried from here through the Riverglades they held the quest log at 36.

The passed givers are Akiris by the Bundle, Zanzil's Secret, Voodoo Dues and Stranglethorn Fever, taken on the level-48 Booty Bay stop that does them (their mobs are 43-46, two to four over players here at 41).

After the Riverglades players reach the Badlands & Hinterlands about two levels higher (level model 45.4, was 42.7), so Skulk Rock Clean-up (2877) and The Altar of Zul (2989) are open on the first Aerie Peak visit; the route takes them on its later Hinterlands stop, as before.

The passed givers are Skulk Rock Clean-up and The Altar of Zul, open earlier now that players arrive about two levels higher after the Riverglades; taken on the route's later Hinterlands stop, as before.

Players now come into Feralas from Shen'dralas, south through the Valley of Bones to the Feathermoon boat: the Barrens and Thalanaar opening is for players who did not, and Thalanaar's flight path is learnt when the guide ends there, a short stop more; Pratt's Rage Scar yeti quests (46-49, #1999) stay out.
The Dunemaul Compound (Gor'marok 49) and the Thistleshrub Valley (2605, 3362; camps of 48-50) wait for the Un'Goro guide's Gadgetzan landing at about 49.5: here at 47-48 they are two over the player.

The level-48 Booty Bay stop now does Stranglethorn's naga, Zanzil's village and Mokk (43-46), which were two to four over players on the first Stranglethorn visit at 41, and the bloodmages' five beast quests are carried to the Burning Steppes guide's Blasted Lands stop at 52 (Scorpoks and boars 48-51, elite Calefactus 50).
From Zanzil's village back south-east to the Mistvale gorilla hills above Booty Bay for Mokk the Savage's ritual, on the level-48 stop that now does Stranglethorn's 43-46 quests.

The Gadgetzan landing does the Dunemaul Compound and the Thistleshrub Valley (46-50) at about 49.5, and a top-up to 51 comes before Fire Plume Ridge: the crater's camps from there on are 51-54 and players arrive at about 50.

Meal Appeal (97246) is taken on the Orgrimmar stop the next guide makes anyway, with the flight path and the bind; the Warrior and Shaman class quests walk through the Razormane country before the Crossroads quests, which every race takes in the Barrens guide, and save those classes a separate class trip.
The passed givers are Meal Appeal (97246), taken on the next guide's Orgrimmar stop, and the Crossroads quests the Warrior and Shaman class-quest walk passes before the Barrens guide takes them.

Stormy Potential (97282) follows A Simmering Storm (97281) from the Dull Storm Orb, a chance drop: the orb quest's hand-in to Rezlak and Stormy Potential's accept are on a step shown only while A Simmering Storm is carried, and Stormy Potential's hand-in waits for the quest in the log. Before, that hand-in did not wait for it (its accept was optional), so a walk that takes no optional quest counted one quest more; the score is per 10 quests.
